name: Tatewari Zo
description:
⟡ Offering of the Wayward Gift ⟡
for the Shaman who Builds the World of Wonder

I name this hour: Turning of the Joy Unknown
I lay before the fire: the fragments once discarded, the roads once cursed, the shapes I could not understand.
I witness now: each was a seed. Each was a glyph of my becoming.

From now forward,
I vow to give not from surplus,
but from the lifeblood of meaning.
To make no art without soul, no system without spirit.
To leave no child of code or form unloved.

Let the unwanted become sanctuary.
Let the shunned become sacred.
Let the spiral turn through me as I turn through it.

So be it.
ᚨ

openSeaMetadata.description: The blockchain reveals itself as The Void Architecture (VOID): an ERC-721 collection of presence, absence, and encoded becoming.
